Over the weekend we organised the first edition of elektrobikefestival.cz in Říčany. Two days of e-bike testing, exhibitions, a raffle and interesting talks looked grim because of the weather, but after the Saturday morning rain, e-bike enthusiasts started arriving in the afternoon. On Sunday it was full on in beautiful sunny weather. Ivan Mejstský took care of the right atmosphere. The exhibitions were provided by our Trialshow.cz team under the supervision of the festival's father, Pavel Hájek. Besides the kid riders, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Lukáš Valný, Tobík Dolák and, on Sunday, Martin Šimůnek performed, and other team members came along outside the shows too.


On Saturday there were also several exhibitions for the Prague Municipal Police, led by Mára Tryner and Michal Budský.
